verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authentication tokens (FIDO2/U2F, PIV, OTP). They have no automation or workflow system that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this story is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships automations. HOTP keyboard emulation and OpenSK firmware builds are not automation versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
